project.title: NASA Psyche Mission: AR/WebXR for Public Engagement—CERNN: Satellite Experience

section.title: Project Overview
section.description: This project envisions an accessible, interactive AR experience that translates complex NASA data into an engaging narrative, allowing users of all ages to explore the Psyche spacecraft and track its journey in real time.

item.name: Interactive 3D Spacecraft
item.detail: Users interact with a glowing 3D model, discovering how onboard instruments support the mission's goal of mapping and analyzing Psyche 16.

item.name: Dynamic Mission Timeline
item.detail: A scrubbable, real-time tracking system highlights critical milestones from launch to orbit, building anticipation through countdowns and progress markers.

item.name: Accessible Design
item.detail: Intuitive mobile gestures ensure audiences of all technical and physical abilities can seamlessly engage with the scientific content.

item.name: Seamless Access
item.detail: Web-based AR/VR launches instantly via QR code from the Psyche Launchpad without requiring app downloads or personal data.

item.name: Accessible UX
item.detail: Bite-sized, single-user educational modules designed for the public, featuring on-demand contextual gesture instructions.

item.name: Mission Progress Tracker
item.detail: Features a real-time countdown to arrival and an explorable 3D spacecraft model tracking the journey to Psyche 16.

item.name: Spacecraft Exploration
item.detail: Interactive 3D inspection that uses visual cues (pulsing highlights) to guide users through discovering and learning about onboard instruments.

item.name: Interactive Timeline
item.detail: Navigable milestone tracker allowing users to explore critical mission events, from launch through future instrument deployments.

section.title: Low-level Design & Establishing Educational Goals
section.description: The Psyche mission demands high informational precision, I summarized research papers and established frameworks and libraries for the project.

item.name: AR Technology Evaluation
item.detail: Researched APIs, libraries, and frameworks, documenting pros/cons to drive the project's technical architecture.

item.name: Scientific Research
item.detail: Synthesized 13+ NASA Psyche research papers—covering mission objectives, geology, and satellite operations—to ensure scientific accuracy across the project.

item.name: High-Fidelity Mockups
item.detail: Designed accessible, user-tested UI/UX mockups for three core AR experiences (Detective, Satellite, and Lore/Astronomer).

item.name: Use Case Architecture
item.detail: Developed UML diagrams to map user interactions, logic flows, and system responsibilities.

item.name: Experience Design Documents (EDDs)
item.detail: Defined the narrative, mechanics, and user flows to establish the creative direction for the sprint.

item.name: Requirements Extraction
item.detail: Translated complex design concepts and scientific research into actionable, developer-ready requirements and info sheets.

section.title: Inclusive Design & Accessibility
section.description: Driven by the mandate to make the Psyche Satellite experience universally accessible, I designed and implemented a suite of user-controlled visual enhancements.

item.name: High-Contrast Optimization
item.detail: Designed custom UI themes to ensure strict legibility standards and support users with visual impairments.

item.name: Dynamic Light & Dark Modes
item.detail: Integrated adaptable color schemes to reduce eye strain and accommodate diverse viewing environments.

item.name: Centralized Customization Hub
item.detail: Prototyped and developed an intuitive settings menu, empowering users to seamlessly tailor their AR experience to their needs.

stage.title: Sprint 3: Components Page and Mission Timeline Page

section.title: Live Mission Tracking & API Integration
section.description: To bring the Psyche mission to life, I architected a data-driven experience that translates complex spacecraft telemetry into accessible, real-time mission progress on the homepage.

item.name: JPL Horizons API Integration
item.detail: Engineered a pipeline to extract and parse live Ephemeris data from the Horizons API, translating raw orbital telemetry into precise distance figures.

item.name: Client-Side Data Architecture
item.detail: Generated a structured, localized XML database to manage and serve satellite distance data efficiently to the frontend interface.

item.name: Mission Phase Visualization
item.detail: Developed dynamic UI components to consume the XML data, allowing users to seamlessly track the satellite's journey and explore distinct mission phases.

stage.title: Sprint 4: About Page, Additional Accessibility Features, User Feedback, and Mobile Features

section.title: AR Accessibility & 3D UI Enhancements
section.description: To make the Augmented Reality experience inclusive and visually immersive, I implemented system-wide accessibility themes and refined the 3D environmental UI components.

item.name: System-Wide Accessibility Theming
item.detail: Engineered dynamic theming architecture to apply high-contrast, light, and color-blind accessible themes across all interactive AR pop-ups and buttons.

item.name: Persistent User Preferences
item.detail: Ensured user accessibility settings translated seamlessly across the entire application, dynamically adapting interface components to meet specific user needs.

item.name: 3D Environment Refinement
item.detail: Enhanced the visual cohesion of the virtual space by upgrading the Skybox floor, bridging the gap between functional UI and an immersive 3D aesthetic.

section.title: Educational UX Design & Data Architecture
section.description: To ensure the experience was highly educational and intuitive for users of all ages and cognitive abilities, I overhauled the content strategy, integrated multimedia elements, and optimized the backend data delivery.

item.name: Information Architecture & Content Strategy
item.detail: Restructured complex technical data for the Mission and Instruments sections into an accessible "What, Why, and How" framework to maximize user comprehension across diverse age groups.

item.name: Multimedia Integration
item.detail: Enriched the educational phases with contextual images and videos, supporting visual learners and increasing overall user retention and engagement.

item.name: Scalable Data Management
item.detail: Re-engineered content delivery by transitioning hardcoded phase data into a structured JSON architecture, improving system scalability and maintaining consistency across the application.

item.name: UX/UI Quality Assurance
item.detail: Refined user flows and interface components to guarantee a polished, highly accessible, and confident user experience for all audiences.
